cards.name: Pandemonium
cards.oracleText: Whenever a creature enters, that creature's controller may have it deal damage equal to its power to any target of their choice.

cards.name: Pandora's Box
cards.oracleText: {3}, {T}: Choose a random summon card from all players' decks. For each player, flip a coin. If the flip ends up heads, put a token creature into play and treat it as though an exact copy of the chosen summon card were just played.
